quests.title: Put the Kettle On
quests.summary: Auntie Val's kettle has given up. Fetch the bits to fix it.

steps.text: Ask the ironmonger at the Silk Museum for a fuse.
Find a spare plug in Buxton.
Take it all back to Auntie Val.

quests.reward: A Flask of Tea and Auntie Val's undying gratitude.

quests.title: Hen Night
quests.summary: Round up three escaped hens before the fox does.

steps.text: Find the hens on the old road over the moor.
